title: Who Authorized It?
objective: Create a cinematic 30-second NerveSystem commercial that makes the AI-authority problem instantly understandable.
target_audience: AI founders, CTOs, CISOs, enterprise technology buyers, robotics and industrial automation leaders
topic: AI agents can act in the real world, but intelligence is not authority
constraints: At least one visible human operator

NerveSystem shown as authority gate, not as magical AI
